newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says capex data at least on forecast.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says capex data at least on forecast.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello on Tuesday told ruling coalition members of parliament that capital expenditure data for the September quarter showed the government would at least meet its budget forecasts.
The data had been unexpectedly strong, "which will enable the government to at least meet its budget forecasts", a Coalition spokesman quoted Costello as saying.
The government forecast in its August budget 14 percent year average growth in business investment for the fiscal year to June 30, 1997.
Figures last week showed private new capital expenditure (capex) rose 0.9 percent in the September quarter, against forecasts which had centred on a 3.0 percent fall.
